Exit: An ancient standing stone etched with glowing runes. Use it to open a gateway to other worlds.
出口: 一块刻满发光符文的古老立石。使用它可打开通往其他世界的传送门。

Exit: A kit containing everything needed to raise a Portal Hub. Place it anywhere — then use the portal to travel to other worlds.
出口: 一套搭建传送枢纽所需的全部材料。将其放置在任意位置——然后使用传送门前往其他世界。

Exit: You begin with a Portal Kit. Place it anywhere to open a gateway to other worlds.
出口: 你初始拥有一个传送门套件。将其放置在任意位置即可打开通往其他世界的传送门。

Exit: Bind a witch stone into fresh fur and dried wolfsbane, sealed with animal fat. Assembles a portable Portal Hub kit.
出口: 将巫石绑入新鲜毛皮与干乌头中，并用动物脂肪密封。制成一套便携式传送枢纽套件。

Exit: A small metal nail, perfect for joining wood. It is the metal it was made from: copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze, white bronze or iron. Heat it and strike it with a hard hammer to raise its quality; each nail takes only a few strikes.
出口: 一枚小金属钉，非常适合连接木材。它的金属与制作它的材料相同：铜、幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜、白青铜或铁。加热后用硬锤敲打可以提高它的品质；每枚钉子只能敲打几次。

Exit: Hammer a nugget of copper, tin, bronze or iron into a nail of the same metal.
出口: 将铜、锡、青铜或铁金属块锤打成同种金属的钉子。

Exit: Crafted: From a copper, tin, bronze or iron nugget using a hammer, or six at a time by casting a heated copper, tin or bronze bar (one mud brick and one clay as the mould). The nail is the metal of its nugget or bar. Heat and smith: In a fire or forge it heats up (shown as a Heated nail) and cools again outside it. A heated nail struck with a hard hammer gains quality from your Smithing skill; each nail takes only a few strikes. Uses: Construction and crafting. A nail of any metal works the same in every recipe, iron included. Smelts: Returns 1 nugget of its own metal in a furnace at 1100°C or hotter.
出口: 制作：用锤子将铜、锡、青铜或铁金属块锤成钉子，或将加热的铜、锡或青铜金属锭浇铸（用1块泥砖和1份黏土作模）一次得到六枚。钉子的金属与所用金属块或金属锭相同。 加热与锻造：在火堆或锻炉中会变热（显示为加热的钉子），离开后会冷却。用硬锤敲打加热的钉子，可依你的金工技能提高品质；每枚钉子只能敲打几次。 用途：建筑和手工制作材料。任何金属的钉子（包括铁钉）在所有配方中作用相同。 熔炼：在1100°C或更高温度的熔炉中返还1块同种金属的金属块。

Exit: A flat metal sheet, hammered thin. It is the metal it was made from: copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze, white bronze or iron. Heat it and strike it with a hard hammer to raise its quality; each sheet takes only a few strikes.
出口: 一块锤打成薄片的金属片。它的金属与制作它的材料相同：铜、幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜、白青铜或铁。加热后用硬锤敲打可以提高它的品质；每块金属片只能敲打几次。

Exit: Hammer a heated bar of copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze or white bronze flat with a hard hammer into a sheet of the same metal. Your Smithing skill adds to its quality.
出口: 用硬锤将加热的铜、幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜或白青铜锭锤打成同种金属的薄片。你的金工技能会提高它的品质。

Exit: Hammer 6 iron nuggets flat into an Iron Sheet (a Metal Sheet of Metal Type 200), ready for iron-grade tools and armor.
出口: 把6块铁块锤打成一块铁片（金属类型200的金属片），可用于打造铁质工具和铠甲。

Exit: A tin solder stick for joining metal parts or sealing seams. A new stick lasts five recipes.
出口: 锡焊料棒，用于连接金属零件或密封接缝。新做的一根可用于五个配方。

Exit: Forge 4 iron nuggets into 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200).
出口: 用4块铁块锻造4枚铁钉（金属类型200的金属钉）。

Exit: Melt a tin-grade metal nugget into a solder stick that lasts five recipes.
出口: 将锡块熔铸成一根可用于五个配方的焊料棒。

Exit: Hammer a heated Ghost Bronze, Tin, Tin Bronze or White Bronze bar flat with a hard hammer into a sheet of the same metal, ready for alloy armor. Your Smithing skill adds to its quality.
出口: 用硬锤将加热的幽灵青铜、锡、锡青铜或白青铜锭锤打成同种金属的薄片，可用于打造合金铠甲。你的金工技能会提高它的品质。
需要加热的青铜级金属锭

Exit: Cast a heated copper, tin or bronze bar into six nails of the same metal.
出口: 将加热的铜、锡或青铜金属锭浇铸成六枚同种金属的钉子。

Exit:
A refined oil used for oil lamps.
It's also fine to use it for frying food or as a seasoning.
出口:
一种用于油灯照明的精炼油料。
你要是拿来油炸食物或作为调料，也不是不行。

Exit: Operation steps: 1. Need to heat fat liquid. 2. Heat and melt 12 pieces of fat in a bowl to obtain a bowl of liquid fat.
出口: 操作步骤： 1. 需要热脂肪液体。 2. 将12块脂肪放在碗中加热融化，得到一碗液体脂肪。

Exit:
A cake of stearin. Can be used as wax for making candles.
It can be thrown directly into a fire, and it is also a very good waterproofing agent and lubricant.
出口:
一块硬脂。可用作制作蜡烛的原料。
可以直接扔进火力燃烧，也是非常好的防水剂和润滑剂。

Exit: Strike the heated sheet with a hard hammer to raise its quality. Each strike uses one of its strikes.
出口: 用硬锤敲打加热的金属片以提高品质。每次敲打消耗一次捶打次数。

Exit: Strike the heated nail with a hard hammer to raise its quality. Each strike uses one of its strikes.
出口: 用硬锤敲打加热的钉子以提高品质。每次敲打消耗一次捶打次数。

Exit: Pour a small crucible of molten copper, tin or bronze into a mould of mud bricks and clay to cast one sheet of the same metal. Your Smithing skill adds to its quality.
出口: 将一个小坩埚中熔化的铜、锡或青铜倒入泥砖和黏土制成的模具，铸成一块同种金属的金属片。你的金工技能会提高它的品质。

Exit: Salt dissolved in water, for pickling and salting food. Food soaking in it is salted, and raw meat or lean fish left in a clay bowl of it cures into Salt-Cured Meat or Fish. A Pickle Vat ferments food in it. Add more salt to make Concentrated Brine.
出口: 盐溶于水而成，可用来腌渍食物。泡在里面的食物会被盐腌，生肉或瘦鱼肉放在装着它的陶碗里会腌成腌肉或腌鱼。腌菜缸用它发酵食物。继续加盐可以做成浓盐水。

Exit: Very salty. Food left in it is salted.
出口: 很咸！放在里面的食物会被盐腌。

Exit: Dissolve the salt in the water to make Brine.
出口: 把盐溶进水里，做成盐水。

Exit: Dissolve more salt in the brine. Salty enough, it becomes Concentrated Brine.
出口: 往盐水里再溶些盐。足够咸时，它会变成浓盐水。

Exit: Raw meat cured in brine. A filling, slow-spoiling travel ration - though the salt will leave you thirsty.
出口: 用盐水腌制的生肉。是一种饱腹感强、不易变质的旅行口粮，不过吃了会让你口渴。

Exit: The salt-cured meat has finally spoiled.
Eat the salt-cured meat. Filling, but salty.
出口: 吃掉这块腌肉。很饱腹，但很咸。

Exit: Lean fish cured in brine. A light, slow-spoiling travel ration that keeps far longer than dried fish - though the salt will leave you thirsty.
出口: 用盐水腌制的瘦鱼。是一种清淡、不易变质的旅行口粮，比鱼干保存得久得多，不过吃了会让你口渴。

Exit: The salt-cured fish has finally spoiled.
Eat the salt-cured fish. Light, but salty.
出口: 吃掉这条腌鱼。味道清淡，但很咸。

Exit: Raw meat soaking in brine. About two days in the brine turn it into Salt-Cured Meat. Kept in a clay bowl holding at least 100 brine it cures; out of the brine it stops curing and spoils like raw meat. Rinse it to get the raw meat back.
出口: 泡在盐水里的生肉。在盐水里泡大约两天就会变成腌肉。放在装有至少100盐水的陶碗里才会腌制；离开盐水后停止腌制，并像生肉一样变质。冲掉盐水即可拿回生肉。

Exit: Take it out of the brine. It is raw again and stops curing; it keeps the salt it soaked up.
出口: 把它从盐水里拿出来。它会变回生肉并停止腌制，但保留吸收的盐分。

Exit: Raw lean fish soaking in brine. About two days in the brine turn it into Salt-Cured Fish. Kept in a clay bowl holding at least 100 brine it cures; out of the brine it stops curing and spoils like raw fish. Rinse it to get the raw fish back.
出口: 泡在盐水里的生瘦鱼肉。在盐水里泡大约两天就会变成腌鱼。放在装有至少100盐水的陶碗里才会腌制；离开盐水后停止腌制，并像生鱼肉一样变质。冲掉盐水即可拿回生鱼肉。

Exit: Take it out of the brine. It is raw again and stops curing; it keeps the salt it soaked up.
出口: 把它从盐水里拿出来。它会变回生鱼肉并停止腌制，但保留吸收的盐分。
